g.text: Cue-locked population responses across the recorded network
Odd trials define normalization and row order; held-out even trials supply the displayed activity.
80 trials | 40 odd / 40 even | -1 to +5 s | neuron-mean traces with SEM
Heatmap colors are clipped at -2 to +4 z. Ribbons are SEM across recorded neurons, not animals.
All four views use the same rate limits and color scale; All pools the three recording areas.
